"""Gradio entry point for the campus shuttle Merge Sort simulator.""" from functools import partial from pathlib import Path import gradio as gr from display import message, render_step from ranking import EXAMPLE, MAX_COUNT, MAX_STOPS, build_steps def show(steps, index=0, notice=""): """Keep the saved position, picture, and navigation buttons in sync.""" active = bool(steps) last = active and index == len(steps) - 1 picture = render_step(steps, index) if active else notice return ( (steps, index), picture, gr.Button(interactive=active and index > 0), gr.Button(interactive=active and not last), gr.Button(interactive=active and not last), ) def start(text): try: steps = build_steps(text) except ValueError as error: return show([], notice=message("Check your input", str(error), error=True)) return show(steps) def editing(): return show([], notice=message("Ready for a new run", "Choose Start simulation to rank the edited stop counts.")) def navigate(session, action): steps, index = session if not steps: return editing() if action == "back": index = max(0, index - 1) elif action == "next": index = min(len(steps) - 1, index + 1) else: index = len(steps) - 1 return show(steps, index) def build_app(): example_steps = build_steps(EXAMPLE) with gr.Blocks(title="Shuttle Stop Crowd Ranking", analytics_enabled=False) as app: # Gradio gives each browser session its own copy of the trace and cursor. session = gr.State((example_steps, 0)) gr.HTML( '<header class="masthead"><h1>Shuttle stop crowd ranking</h1>' '<p>Use Merge Sort to decide where to send an extra campus shuttle.</p></header>' ) with gr.Row(elem_id="workspace"): with gr.Column(scale=2, min_width=265, elem_id="controls"): entry = gr.Textbox( value=EXAMPLE, label="Stop counts", lines=5, max_lines=14, info=f"Enter 1–{MAX_STOPS} stops, one per line. Use a name, a comma, and a count from 0 to {MAX_COUNT}.", ) start_button = gr.Button("Start simulation", variant="primary") gr.HTML('<p class="input-help">Use Next step to explore the sample, or edit the rows and choose Start simulation.</p>') with gr.Column(scale=4, min_width=310, elem_id="viewer"): picture = gr.HTML(render_step(example_steps, 0), elem_id="picture") with gr.Row(elem_id="navigation"): back = gr.Button("Back", interactive=False, min_width=65) forward = gr.Button("Next step", variant="primary", min_width=94) finish = gr.Button("Show result", min_width=112) outputs = [session, picture, back, forward, finish] # Process input edits, restarts and navigation in the order they arrive. events = {"outputs": outputs, "show_progress": "hidden", "concurrency_id": "simulation"} entry.change(editing, **events) start_button.click(start, inputs=entry, **events) back.click(partial(navigate, action="back"), inputs=session, **events) forward.click(partial(navigate, action="next"), inputs=session, **events) finish.click(partial(navigate, action="result"), inputs=session, **events) return app if __name__ == "__main__": theme = gr.themes.Base(primary_hue="teal", neutral_hue="slate", font=["Inter", "system-ui", "sans-serif"]) build_app().launch(theme=theme, css_paths=Path(__file__).with_name("style.css"), footer_links=[]) """Input rules, stable Merge Sort, and the campus shuttle decision.""" from dataclasses import dataclass, field MAX_STOPS = 12 MAX_COUNT = 999 MAX_NAME = 40 MAX_TEXT = 2000 EXAMPLE = """Stauffer Library, 18 West Campus, 32 Athletics Centre, 32 Union Street, 7""" @dataclass(frozen=True) class Stop: name: str count: int @dataclass class Step: """A snapshot of one operation. Rows are shown in their list order.""" kind: str note: str left: list[Stop] = field(default_factory=list) right: list[Stop] = field(default_factory=list) output: list[Stop] = field(default_factory=list) def parse_stops(text: str | None) -> list[Stop]: """Read one 'stop name, count' per line and report the first bad row.""" text = text or "" if len(text) > MAX_TEXT: raise ValueError(f"Use at most {MAX_TEXT} characters for one run.") stops = [] first_seen = {} for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1): if not line.strip(): continue if len(stops) == MAX_STOPS: raise ValueError(f"Use up to {MAX_STOPS} stops. Remove the extra row on line {line_number}.") parts = line.split(",") if len(parts) != 2: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} needs one comma, for example Library, 18.") name = " ".join(parts[0].split()) count_text = parts[1].strip() if not name or len(name) > MAX_NAME: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} needs a stop name of 1–{MAX_NAME} characters.") if not count_text.isascii() or not count_text.isdecimal(): raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} needs a whole number from 0 to {MAX_COUNT}.") count = int(count_text) if count > MAX_COUNT: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} exceeds {MAX_COUNT} people. Check the estimate.") # A second estimate for the same stop would give it two places in the ranking. key = name.casefold() previous_line = first_seen.get(key) if previous_line is not None: raise ValueError(f"Line {line_number} repeats the stop on line {previous_line}. Keep one estimate per stop.") first_seen[key] = line_number stops.append(Stop(name, count)) if not stops: raise ValueError("Enter at least one stop, for example Library, 18.") return stops def merge(left: list[Stop], right: list[Stop], steps: list[Step]) -> list[Stop]: """Combine two ranked groups, recording each choice for the viewer.""" merged = [] left_index = right_index = 0 while left_index < len(left) and right_index < len(right): left_stop, right_stop = left[left_index], right[right_index] # Save the groups before advancing a pointer so both candidates stay visible. left_before = left[left_index:] right_before = right[right_index:] # Choosing left on a tie keeps earlier input rows ahead of later ones. if left_stop.count >= right_stop.count: chosen, other = left_stop, right_stop left_index += 1 else: chosen, other = right_stop, left_stop right_index += 1 merged.append(chosen) if left_stop.count == right_stop.count: note = (f"Both stops have {left_stop.count} waiting. Take {chosen.name} from the left " "because it appeared earlier in the input.") else: note = (f"{chosen.name} has {chosen.count} waiting and {other.name} has " f"{other.count}. Take {chosen.name} next.") # Later appends must not change a step that the user can revisit. steps.append(Step("pick", note, left_before, right_before, merged.copy())) # At most one group has any stops left. Its tail is already in order. left_tail, right_tail = left[left_index:], right[right_index:] merged.extend(left_tail) merged.extend(right_tail) side = "left" if left_tail else "right" note = f"Only the {side} group has stops left. Append them in the order shown." steps.append(Step("tail", note, left_tail, right_tail, merged.copy())) return merged def merge_sort(stops: list[Stop], steps: list[Step]) -> list[Stop]: """Return a new list ordered by descending crowd count.""" if len(stops) <= 1: if stops: steps.append(Step("single", "A group with one stop needs no comparisons.", output=stops.copy())) return stops.copy() middle = len(stops) // 2 left_half = stops[:middle] right_half = stops[middle:] steps.append(Step("split", "Divide this group at the middle. Work through the left half first.", left=left_half, right=right_half)) left = merge_sort(left_half, steps) right = merge_sort(right_half, steps) return merge(left, right, steps) def dispatch_decision(ranked: list[Stop]) -> str: """Explain the decision using the completed, nonempty ranking.""" first = ranked[0] if first.count == 0: return "Keep the extra shuttle on standby. Every stop reported zero people waiting." if len(ranked) > 1 and first.count == ranked[1].count: return (f"Send the extra shuttle to {first.name}. The highest count is {first.count}. " "Of the stops tied for first, this one was entered earliest.") return f"Send the extra shuttle to {first.name}. Its count of {first.count} is the highest reported." def build_steps(text: str) -> list[Step]: stops = parse_stops(text) steps = [Step("start", "Read the stops in the order entered. The numbers are people waiting.", output=stops)] ranked = merge_sort(stops, steps) steps.append(Step("done", dispatch_decision(ranked), output=ranked)) return steps """Turn a saved Merge Sort step into labelled HTML for Gradio.""" from html import escape from ranking import Step, Stop TITLES = { "start": "Input order", "split": "Split the group", "single": "One stop is already sorted", "pick": "Compare the front stops", "tail": "Append the remaining stops", "done": "Final ranking", } def group(title: str, stops: list[Stop], tone: str, front=False, added=0) -> str: """Draw one row of stop cards. A text label accompanies each highlight.""" cards = [] for index, stop in enumerate(stops): marker = "" if front and index == 0: marker = "Front" if index >= len(stops) - added: marker = "Added" tag = f'<small>{marker}</small>' if marker else "" marked = " marked" if marker else "" cards.append( f'<li class="stop {tone}{marked}">{tag}' f'<span>{escape(stop.name)}</span><b>{stop.count}</b></li>' ) content = '<ol class="cards">' + "".join(cards) + '</ol>' if not stops: content = '<p class="empty-group">Empty group</p>' return f'<section class="group"><h3>{title}</h3>{content}</section>' def ordered_rows(stops: list[Stop], final: bool) -> str: """Show positions and exact counts. Final bars use the busiest stop as their scale.""" rows = [] for position, stop in enumerate(stops, start=1): bar = "" if final: width = 100 * stop.count / stops[0].count if stops[0].count else 0 bar = (f'<span class="track" aria-hidden="true">' f'<span style="width:{width:.2f}%"></span></span>') rows.append( f'<li><span class="position">{position:02d}</span>' f'<span class="stop-name">{escape(stop.name)}{bar}</span>' f'<b class="count">{stop.count}</b></li>' ) heading = "Dispatch order" if final else "As entered" return (f'<div class="list-label"><span>{heading}</span><span>People waiting</span></div>' f'<ol class="stop-list">{"".join(rows)}</ol>') def render_step(steps: list[Step], index: int) -> str: step = steps[index] if step.kind == "start" or step.kind == "done": visual = ordered_rows(step.output, final=step.kind == "done") elif step.kind == "single": visual = group("Sorted group", step.output, "output") else: compare = step.kind == "pick" groups = (group("Left group", step.left, "left", front=compare) + group("Right group", step.right, "right", front=compare)) visual = f'<div class="halves">{groups}</div>' if step.kind != "split": added = 1 if compare else len(step.left) + len(step.right) visual += group("Merged after this step", step.output, "output", added=added) note_class = "decision" if step.kind == "done" else "step-note" return ( '<article class="board">' f'<div class="progress-label">Step {index + 1} of {len(steps)}</div>' f'<progress value="{index + 1}" max="{len(steps)}" aria-label="Simulation progress"></progress>' f'<h2>{TITLES[step.kind]}</h2><p class="{note_class}">{escape(step.note)}</p>' f'{visual}</article>' ) def message(title: str, detail: str, error=False) -> str: role = "alert" if error else "status" style = " error" if error else "" return (f'<article class="board{style}" role="{role}">' f'<h2>{escape(title)}</h2><p>{escape(detail)}</p></article>') from app import build_app build_app().launch()
